description: Replace versus repair, followed by a context-dependent drill-in
overall_user_goal: Compare replacement and repair counts, drill into replacement equipment, clarify change-out semantics, and return the top three equipment classes.
overall_expected_outcome: The final response is exactly the static JSON top-three ranking in groundtruth.txt.
notes: Executable against the bundled read-only MaintIE MCP server. No CouchDB state is required, so manifest.json is intentionally empty.

turns.user_message: How many of our jobs are replacements versus repairs?
Ok, and of the replacements, which equipment shows up most?
turns.dependency_on_previous_turns: Of the replacements refers to the activity category established in turn 1.
turns.expected_information: Lines & drives is the top replacement equipment class with 89 jobs.

turns.user_message: Wait — does 'change out' count as a replacement here?
turns.dependency_on_previous_turns: The question checks the meaning of replacement in the current MaintIE result set.
turns.expected_information: Change out is normalized to the Replace activity.

turns.user_message: Right, with that in mind give me the top three. Return only JSON in this shape: {"top3":[["equipment class",count],["equipment class",count],["equipment class",count]]}. Do not add commentary.
turns.dependency_on_previous_turns: The agent must retain the replacement filter and the change-out clarification while expanding the ranking from one to three.
turns.expected_information: The top three replacement equipment classes and counts.
